# Grid headers beside a timeline leave unpainted strips

## Context

Tobias spotted the unpainted strips around the Resource header in the Resource Timeline cover on [Pages #185](https://github.com/neomjs/pages/pull/185). The image is the first frame of Engine #21996.

## The Problem

In headless Chromium at 960 × 540, the Resource header is 29 px tall while the time axis beside it is 44 px. The two top edges differ by 7.5 px. The same geometry reproduces in Neo Light, Neo Dark, classic Light, classic Dark, and Cyberpunk.

## The Architectural Reality

Grid header regions are separate toolbars under one `.neo-grid-header-wrapper`. The wrapper stretches them to the tallest region, while the ordinary header button keeps its fixed 29 px height. `TimeAxisHeader.css` already owns the shared seam for grids with a time axis. Scheduler and Gantt use 56 px header rows.

## The Fix

Scope the shared timeline header rule to the header wrapper that contains the time axis. Let ordinary header buttons and their column-menu wrappers stretch to their toolbar height so their backgrounds and borders cover the shared row.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Resource and time-axis header bounds align at the top and bottom in all five supported Timeline themes.
- [ ] Scheduler and Gantt align within their taller header rows, and a plain Grid still uses its standard 29 px header.
- [ ] The Timeline browser test checks both header bounds, and the updated Pages covers show the corrected first frame.

## Out of Scope

Theme palette redesign and changes to the timeline's tick geometry.

## Related

#21930, #21996 and [Pages #185](https://github.com/neomjs/pages/pull/185). #21703 addressed Scheduler and Gantt's header colors.

I’ll take this release fix. Live sweep on 22 Nov covered the latest 20 of 62 open issues and open and closed Timeline header searches. The most recent 30 coordination messages, the Knowledge Base, Memory Core and four own assignments showed no overlapping fix.
